name: Webel Siliguri Data Centre
developer: West Bengal Electronics Industry Development Corporation Limited (Webel)
notes: Webel planned its third state data centre at Siliguri; DCD reports the project, Millennium Post reported first-phase 6 MW capacity, and a May 2025 Times of India report says Webel IT Park AI/data-centre infrastructure was inaugurated with about Rs 100 crore investment. Webel lists Siliguri IT Park at Paribahan Nagar, Matigara, Siliguri, Dist. Darjeeling.

name: Yotta Kolkata / Uttarpara Hyperscale Data Center Park
notes: Hiranandani/Yotta announced six hyperscale data centre buildings totaling 250 MW on a 100-acre Uttarpara/Hind Motor site in Hooghly district; Times of India reported 20 acres for data centre use and first data centre building targeted for 2023.
